day0_note:
these are EXECUTED orders reconstructed by lockstep; hands also WATER each new plant the next hour, FEED/CARE animals right after PLACE. Full raw tapes incl. moves: tapes_all.json (key '_

'). DSM h0 uses three separate SHEEP 1 orders; MMPQ buys COW 1 + WHEAT 5 at h0 and SHEEP 3 (one order) at h1. For an exact d0 copy replay a DSM raw tape (tapes_all.json, any key with tag DSM; 15/15 identical to h21).

NE.trigger: first hour on d6 where cash + same-step sale proceeds >= 1000 (wool/fert sold in the same market list BEFORE the BUY_LAND order)

SW.trigger: first hour cash+same-step proceeds >= 2000 on d8-9 (funded by d8 h1 milk sale + fert)

SE.trigger: same step as the first SELL MELON of the d0 melon harvest; order list [SELL MELON ..., BUY_LAND]

d10_d27.hours: 8 at h0 (market list = 8-9 HIRE + 1-2 SELL) + 4 at h1

herd_keyed_at_d10.note: dX3 = units/4h demanded by the first 3 drawn shops (d3,d6,d9) for product X: shop with 1 product counts 2 (YARN_STORE for wool, PET_CAFE for carrot), multi-product shops count 1
herd_keyed_at_d10.V183_for_contrast: sheep 2.7+4.9*dW2 (keys on 2 shops only), cows 5.0+3.2*dM2, geese ~5.9 flat (bought d2)

crops_keyed.tomato_tiles_d18: 10.5 + 6.8*dT5 (R2 0.88; dT5 = tomato demand of first 5 shops, i.e. known by d15)
crops_keyed.tomato_first_plant: d8 (d8-10 in 36/37 farms), independent of tomato shops; total tomato plantings 7-38 scale with tomato demand
crops_keyed.carrot: first plant d10-26, volume 5-108 plantings; key NOT determined (weak link to carrot shops)

fertilize.STRAWBERRY: age 9 and 13 (two applications cover the 4 production nights 9,11,13,15)
fertilize.leftover: ~240 units/game sold, 1-2 per step, mostly h0/h2/h22 (d<=12 at 0.85-1.0 base, later at floor 0.1-0.5 base)

feed_gate.cow: last FEED = last production night <= d28 (252/301 animals); typical d27
feed_gate.goose: last FEED d27-28 (= last production night or 1 day before)
feed_gate.sheep: last FEED = last production night for 135/230; 42 skip the last cycle (stop 3 days earlier) and ~26 stop 4-7 days earlier -> sheep count 6.2 (d21) -> 3.8 (d27) -> 0.3 (d28). Trigger for the early stop NOT determined (probably wool price vs 3 wheat)

selling.premium_hours: STRAWBERRY, MILK, WOOL: sell at h%4==1 (h1,5,9,13,17,21) right after each town shop tick; P(sell|stock) at those hours 0.37-0.89 (straw), 0.26-0.87 (milk), 0.52-0.63 (wool); other hours <0.2
selling.premium_lot: strawberry k=2 if stock>=6 else 1; milk k=2 if stock>=6, 1 if 3-5, 0-1 if <3; wool 0-1 if stock<6 (~50% of ticks), 1 if 6-11, 2 if >=12. At h%4==1 with stock>=3: sell in ~65% (straw) / 55% (milk) / 60% (wool) of ticks; rest HELD (EOD shed strawberry ~13 on d16 vs V183 0).
selling.premium_price_dependence: weak: straw sold fraction 0.07 at price<0.1*base, 0.17-0.29 at 0.2-0.7, 0.33-0.40 at >=0.9; they do NOT refuse to sell at the floor (wool decile-10 price 0.12*base)
selling.tomato_carrot_egg: end/start of day: h22-23 (P 0.75-0.89) and h0 (0.28-0.39); lots 1-2 or whole stock (10-13)
selling.melon: sold d10-d18 on harvest, lots of 6 (one tile), h0/h6-h11
selling.wheat: sold in lots <10 at almost every hour (h22 94, h0 75, h1 77, h2 50, h18-20 ~28 each /farm over d11-29); d29 dump ~100
selling.d29: sell all remaining (wheat 97, carrot 37, egg 22, straw 16, tomato 15, milk 12, fert 12, wool 6 units/farm)
selling.V183_contrast: V183 sells whole stock (sold/stock median 1.00) on h0-1 and h17-23; eggs every step; carrots at h0
selling.premium_skip_trigger: NOT determined (4h price change, price vs own last sale, previous-tick sale all tested; none separates)

wheat.buy_after_d10: T3 ~5.2k coins total, lots of 13 at h0-1 when shed wheat short
wheat.reserve: EOD shed wheat / animals: 1.7-2.3 (d11-15), 1.2-1.7 (d16-27); intra-day minimum 0 (just-in-time)

endgame_last_day_median.BUY_ANIMAL: cow 9, goose 9-10 (none after d11 except rare)
